title: Query Exit Codes
description: Scan a SINGLE workload's logs for exit-code lines via the shared log ingestion and deduplication pipeline ([[ai-triage-classify-and-mask-logs]]). Use this to see the exit codes in context alongside surrounding log lines. For a cross-pod tally of which pods exited non-zero, use [[query-pod-exit-codes]] instead, which aggregates via the Python native API rather than scanning logs.

workload_name.description: The name prefix of the workload/jobset.

restart_attempt.description: JobSet restart attempt index (optional, default -1 to scan across all attempts in one pass). When >= 0, filters logs specifically for this restart attempt.

last_occurrence.description: Optional timestamp baseline; defaults to current UTC time if omitted.

output_file.description: Output path for deduplicated exit code logs.
